ghi_chu: Tập 2: đốc bưu, lang bạt, kinh đô 189, liên quân 190

nhan_vat_phu.docbuu: a provincial inspector in his fifties, thin arrogant face, small moustache, official black cap and formal pale-grey robe
nhan_vat_phu.hoanquan: a court eunuch, smooth beardless pale face, black official cap and long dark-purple official robe, hands tucked in sleeves
nhan_vat_phu.tuongquan: a Han army commander in his forties, stern face, short beard, iron scale armour over a red robe, plain helmet
nhan_vat_phu.dan: a poor peasant man, thin, sunburnt, ragged hemp tunic, hair in a topknot
nhan_vat_phu.linhde: Emperor Ling of Han, a plump pale man of about 28 in a black and dark-red ceremonial robe and a flat-topped crown with hanging bead strings, bored indulgent expression, seated on a plain low throne
nhan_vat_phu.congtonton: Gongsun Zan, a lean tall commander of about 35, sharp handsome face, thin moustache, strong clear gaze, dark-blue cross-collared robe under light iron scale armour
nhan_vat_phu.hatien: He Jin, a heavy-set man of about 50 with a broad red face and a short beard, dark-red official robe and a black official cap, confident arrogant bearing
nhan_vat_phu.vienthieu: Yuan Shao, a handsome tall man of about 35 with a neat short beard, proud composed look, deep-blue official robe over light armour
nhan_vat_phu.dongtrac: Dong Zhuo, a huge heavy fat man of about 55 with a thick neck, a heavy cruel face with a short thick beard, narrow suspicious eyes, dark fur-trimmed robe over an iron breastplate
nhan_vat_phu.thieude: Emperor Shao of Han, a thin pale frightened boy of about fourteen in rumpled dark-red robes and a small crooked crown
nhan_vat_phu.hiende: Liu Xie, a small serious boy of about nine in a plain dark robe, hair in two small tufts
nhan_vat_phu.luubinh: Liu Ping, a thin sour-faced official of about 40 with a pointed beard, plum-coloured robe and a black cap, contemptuous expression
nhan_vat_phu.thichkhach: an assassin, a lean man of about 30 in plain dark clothes, a cloth tied across his lower face, hands empty
nhan_vat_phu.taotao: Cao Cao, a short wiry man of about 35 with sharp clever eyes, a thin moustache and a small beard, dark-blue robe with plain light armour
nhan_vat_phu.tonkien: Sun Jian, a strong broad-faced man of about 45 with a short beard, a red cloth headband, red robe and iron armour
nhan_vat_phu.linhhan: a Han foot soldier, adult man with a weathered face, plain dark iron helmet, grey-brown leather and iron-scale armour over a plain red tunic, long wooden-shafted spear
nhan_vat_phu.giacuop: a bandit rebel, lean adult man with a plain brown cloth tied around his head, ragged brown hemp tunic, wooden-shafted spear
nhan_vat_phu.linhbien: a frontier soldier from the north-west, broad adult man with a thick beard, round fur cap, dark fur-trimmed iron-scale armour, long spear
nhan_vat_phu.linhtonkien: a soldier of Sun Jian, adult man with a red cloth headband, plain red tunic, light iron armour, long spear
nhan_vat_phu.huahung: Hua Xiong, a huge burly general of about 40 with a fierce square face and a black beard, black iron armour with a dark-green cloak and a heavy iron helmet
nhan_vat_phu.dancu: a poor refugee villager, adult man with a cloth bundle on his back, ragged hemp clothes, tired face
nhan_vat_phu.thieude_lung: a thin pale teenage boy of about fourteen in rumpled dark-red robes, hair in a topknot under a small flat cap, clearly a boy
nhan_vat_phu.quanlai: a county clerk, thin adult man in a plain grey robe and a small black cloth cap, bowing respectfully

a closed wooden door of a roadside guest house at dusk with a pair of straw sandals before the step

a distant small man seen from behind hurrying along a moonlit road, a tiny figure in a wide dark landscape, exactly one man, arms hidden

waist-up of a lean man in dark plain clothes looking down with a troubled conscience, exactly one man, his arms hidden

three men sitting on a reed mat around a low table sharing a steaming pot of food, Liu Bei in the middle, a small bronze oil lamp with a tiny open flame on the table, their hands resting below the table edge, warm humble room, exactly three men
three small distant figures walking side by side along a long dusty road at sunset, seen from far away from behind, exactly three men
the tall gate towers of a great palace at dusk with a cracked wall and a flag hanging limp

waist-up of a heavy-set general in a dark-red robe and black cap, confident arrogant bearing, exactly one man, his arms hidden in his sleeves
waist-up two-shot of a heavy-set general and a pale beardless eunuch facing each other with tense expressions, exactly two men, their hands hidden in sleeves
a bamboo message tube and a rolled summons scroll sealed with a red cord on a dark wooden table, candlelight

a narrow palace corridor at night with torchlight and long shadows, in the foreground a pale beardless court eunuch in a dark-purple robe waits in the shadow behind a wooden pillar with his hands hidden in his sleeves looking down the corridor, far down the corridor the small figure of a heavy-set general in a dark-red robe walks away from the viewer, exactly two men
waist-up of Yuan Shao in light armour, stern determined face, one hand resting on his belt, exactly one man, the other arm hidden

two boys seen from behind walking side by side along a dark river bank at night, a thin teenage boy in rumpled dark-red robes with his hair in a topknot under a small flat cap and a small boy of about nine in a plain dark robe with two small tufts of hair, their backs to the viewer, moonlight on the water, tall reeds, exactly two boys, both clearly male

waist-up two-shot of Cao Cao and Sun Jian standing side by side, serious faces, exactly two men, their outer arms hidden
